name: Towerium
description: A manual-aim tower defense game: aim and fire your weapons, collect powers, and upgrade your tower as increasingly intense enemy waves close in.
controls: Aim + fire · mouse, keyboard or touch

name: The Impossible Tower
description: Hop across enemy platforms in time with the beat. Release and tap again at the peak to dash through gaps, gravity wells, and lightning-filled routes.
controls: Hold to hop · Space or touch

name: Alto’s Tower
description: Race across a sweeping landscape, time your jumps, and keep your momentum. A flowing Tower-inspired adventure where one more run is always tempting.

name: Boom Boom Tower
description: Hit color-coded rocket notes in time with the music. Choose a song and difficulty, find your rhythm, and keep your timing sharp as the chart intensifies.
controls: Four rocket inputs · keyboard, gamepad or touch

name: Cointraptions
description: Build a contraption that routes enemies through your apparatus to dismantle the tower. Solve campaign puzzles, earn coins, and unlock new parts for your next invention.
controls: Place + drag parts · Space runs, R rotates

name: Orble
description: Aim a limited supply of balls through Tower-inspired courses. Ricochet into orange targets, collect bonuses, and use your core ability to make every shot count.
controls: Aim + launch · mouse, touch or keyboard

name: Bemerged
description: Combine your pieces, plan your board, and turn small upgrades into powerful combinations. A Tower-inspired puzzle built around the next clever merge.
controls: Drag to merge · mouse or touch

name: Inner Land Minesweeper
description: Arm mines, chain their blasts, and hook a charged cluster into the shielded boss. Clear the field, then beat your own time.
controls: Tap to arm and detonate · mouse or touch

name: Powerstone
description: Command three lanes in a turn-based duel. Spend mana, combine Tower-inspired cards, and break the enemy Nexus before your own tower falls.
controls: Play cards + end turn · mouse or touch
